desc: Parse `H, W, X`, the starting position, and the grid of strengths.
Initialize Takahashi’s strength, mark the starting cell visited, and add adjacent cells to the heap.
Store coordinates in heap entries and complete the greedy absorption loop with strict inequality.
Add all unvisited neighbors of each absorbed cell to the frontier.
Output the final strength with Python integer arithmetic and maintain `O(HW \log(HW))` complexity.
